Bionic.description:
A part fitted in place of the player's own: a grade of the power cell, the legs or the
feet, the datajack or the eye.
Bionic.title: Bionic

Body.description:
Each part of the player's body that can be sold or replaced: still `present`, `sold`, or
the bionic fitted in its place. A whole body has every part present.

stomach.description: Left out while it's still theirs, as in a save from before it could go.

feet.description: Left out while they're still theirs, as in a save from before they could go.

Body.title: Body

Effect.description: An ailment the player has, which fades on its own or lasts until it's treated.

strength.description: How bad it is, up to 1. It's gone once it fades to 0.
strength.title: Strength

fades.description: The strength it loses each sim hour, or null while it lasts until it's treated, at the clinic or with medicine.
fades.title: Fades

since.description: When they got it, in sim time.
since.title: Since

Effect.title: Effect

EffectKind.description:
An ailment and its cause: a `rat_bite`, the `infection` an untreated bite can turn into, or
a dose of `radiation`.
EffectKind.title: EffectKind

id.description: What it is, the same for every one of its kind, e.g. "copper_wire" or "lamp". Salvage is priced by it.
id.title: Id

name.description: What the player sees, e.g. "Copper wire".
name.title: Name

weight.description: In kg, counted against the carry limit.
weight.title: Weight

charge.description: A lamp's battery, from 0 (flat) to 1 (full). It runs down while the lamp is on, and at a plug it charges, on or off. Null for anything else.
charge.title: Charge

on.description: Whether a lamp is switched on, running its battery down. The player switches it, and it goes off by itself when it's flat. Null for anything else.
on.title: On

ItemKind.description: What it's for: `salvage` to sell, `food` to eat, the `lamp` to see by, or a `part` to fit.
ItemKind.title: ItemKind

MapTile.description: A tile on a given map: the village or an interior, or in side view a street or a floor.
MapTile.title: MapTile

Mind.description:
What the player knows, which they keep when they collapse, and later when they die. Left
out of `Player` while they know no recipe.

recipes.description: The recipes they know, by the bionic each builds, in the order they learned them.
recipes.title: Recipes

sold.description: The recipes they've sold to the clinic, in the order they sold them. They still know each, and can't sell it again. Left out while there's none.
sold.title: Sold

Mind.title: Mind

Pile.description:
Items, money or both lying `at` a tile in the world for the player to pick up, such as
salvage, a secret's cash, or what they left when they collapsed.

money.description: Cash lying there, which weighs nothing. Left out while there's none.
money.title: Money

Pile.title: Pile

Sale.description: Something the player sold that its buyer keeps for them to buy back.

place.description: The buyer that has it, by its place, e.g. "scrap_stall".
place.title: Place

Sale.title: Sale

description:
The player's state, saved with the world. Each field defaults to the starting player's, so
a save from before the player loads with a whole body, no money, a charged lamp, nothing known,
full health, no effects and nothing searched. Their humanity is derived from the bionics
fitted and isn't a field, so the client never sees it.

money.description: In the same units as the residents' money.
money.title: Money

items.description: What they carry. Picking things up keeps their weight within `carry_limit`.
items.title: Items

carry_limit.description: The most they carry, in kg.
carry_limit.title: Carry Limit

hunger.description: 0 is fed and 1 is starving: they collapse.
hunger.title: Hunger

power.description: Their power cell's charge, from 1 (full) to 0 (flat: they collapse), which they run on in place of hunger once a cell is in their stomach. It stays full without one. Left out while it's full.
power.title: Power

health.description: From 1, unhurt, to 0, when they collapse. Left out while it's full.
health.title: Health

effects.description: Their ailments, in the order they got them, each kind once. Left out while there's none.
effects.title: Effects

left.description: What they left lying in the world, oldest first: what they carried when they collapsed, on the tile they fell on or the ground below it, and anything of a pickup that didn't fit when they took from it. Left out while there's none.
left.title: Left

taken.description: When they last took from each pickup in the world, in sim time, by pickup id. Salvage lies there again a while after it was taken, but a secret, cash or a ration, stays taken for good. Left out while there's none.
taken.title: Taken

sales.description: What they've sold that its buyer keeps for them to buy back, oldest first. Left out while there's none.
sales.title: Sales

searched.description: The searchable things and jacks they've searched, by interactable id, in the order they searched them. Each is searched once, and holds nothing after. Left out while there's none.
searched.title: Searched

title: Player
